records.note: Made-up number in the shape of a parcel the app tracked to Malta, for which ParcelsApp named Sengi and MaltaPost: five letters, nine digits and MT. Its serial sits far beyond the range in use.

Made-up number in the shape of a parcel the app tracked to Italy: an SDA waybill of three digits, C, eight digits and F. Sengi's tracker answered it with its leg to the handover, which a universal provider relayed under Sengi's name, before SDA knew it. The shape is SDA's, so detection leaves Sengi out.
